newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Monark to open Asian hub in Philippines' Subic.
newsitem.headline: Monark to open Asian hub in Philippines' Subic.

text.p: Monark Equipment Corp said on Monday it would open its Asian warehousing facility inside the Subic free port zone in northern Philippines.
Monark is the exclusive distributor of construction equipment, forklifts and generator sets of Caterpillar Inc.
Monark said it intended to make Subic the base for its regional operations, which will eventually supply support services to Caterpillar customers in other Asian countries.

"This investment in Subic Bay Freeport is foreseen to play a key role for providing logistics support when and where needed at the most cost-effective means," Monark chief executive officer J.A. Banson said in a statement.
